newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Raiffeisen says arranged big Nitroil deal.
newsitem.headline: Raiffeisen says arranged big Nitroil deal.

text.p: The Hungarian securities arm of Austria's Raiffeisen group said on Monday that Raiffeisen's UK unit brokered the over-the-counter sale of a 29 percent stake in the Hungarian chemicals engineering firm Nitroil Rt.
"A 29 percent stake of Nitroil's issued share capital changed hands with Raiffeisen's London branch brokering the deal," said Attila Berecz, trader at Raiffeisen Securities in Budapest.
Institutional investors were on the selling side of the deal, while Raiffeisen declined to name the buyers or to disclose the purchase price.
The deal was completed late last week.
Nitroil has an issued share capital of 274.9 million forints.
The company's shares are among the most illiquid stocks traded on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE). Last Friday Nitroil shares closed at 17,050 forints.
